narr: Deep moisture over northern Arizona lead to scattered thunderstorms with heavy rain that caused flash flooding.
ev: A creek in Payson rose 19 inches. Water was flowing across one lane of Highway 87.
Substantial flooding was reported within Vernon. County Roads 3131, 3137, and 3187 were impassable.
Water and debris were flowing over the roadways in Polacca/Second Mesa.
A video showed a significant rise of water flowing through the wash.
A photo on social media showed a dirt road that was partially washed out north of Greasewood Springs Chapter House. A video on social media also showed a significant rise on wash.
